listings.title: Glasshouse on the Quay
listings.description: A low-slung glass villa that follows the light. The living floor opens on three sides to a sheltered terrace above the quay, so the water is the first and last thing you see. Built in 2021 to a high thermal standard, with a ground-floor studio and a heated double garage behind.

listings.title: Kijani Ridge Virgin Land
listings.address: Kijani Ridge, off the Northgate road

land.landmarks: Ridge line with valley views to the south
land.utilities: Grid power at the boundary, no water connection
land.restrictions: No planning permission granted for buildings. Spring on the boundary is a habitat - do not infill.

listings.description: Twenty acres that have never been built on, still carrying its original scrub and standing timber. The ridge runs along the southern boundary and looks over the valley, which is the reason anyone buys here. Graded track to the gate, grid power at the boundary, and a clean freehold title with a searching certificate on file.
